title: The Quality Gate Becomes Something That Actually Runs
description: กฎคุณภาพของโปรเจกต์ถูกประกาศไว้ครบแต่ไม่มีอะไรบังคับ: pre-commit hook ไม่เคยถูกเปิดใช้เพราะ core.hooksPath เก็บอยู่ใน .git/config ซึ่ง commit ไม่ได้, CI ไม่ครอบ feature branch ที่งานจริงเกิดขึ้น, ชุดทดสอบฐานข้อมูลที่ handoff อ้างเป็นหลักฐานถูก skip ทุกครั้งใน CI, และ roadmap pointer แตกจากไฟล์เวอร์ชันได้โดย checker มองไม่เห็น รอบนี้ทำให้ทั้งสามอย่างบังคับได้ด้วยเครื่อง ไม่ใช่ด้วยความจำของคน
scope: run the hook setup from the prepare lifecycle so a fresh clone gets the gate without anyone remembering a command
skip hook setup silently when there is no Git work tree, so a tarball or export install does not fail a deployment
run the quality gate on feature branches, where the commits actually land
give CI a PostgreSQL 16 service pinned by digest, matching the production target in ADR 0002, and apply migrations before the suites run
set ESTIMETR_DB_TESTS in CI so the suites the handoff notes claim as verification are the suites that run
make check-roadmap refuse a pointer that has drifted from its versioned file, or that names a version with no file
cover both the workflow contract and the checker behaviour with tests that run in every gate, including the local hook
verification: pnpm install prints the prepare step and git config core.hooksPath reports hooks afterwards, starting from an unset value
tests assert the workflow carries a digest-pinned postgres image, sets ESTIMETR_DB_TESTS, applies migrations before the suites and triggers on feature branches
tests drive scripts/check-roadmap.mjs against fixtures: a matching pair passes, an edited pointer fails with drifted, a missing versioned file fails, and a pointer missing required fields still fails
the same checker passes against this repository as it stands
pnpm typecheck, pnpm lint and pnpm test pass
rollback: Revert the v0.18.0 commit. The hook stays configured on machines where pnpm install already ran; git config --unset core.hooksPath removes it. No schema, migration or product behaviour changes in this version.
constraints: The no-database part of the gate keeps running with the database environment variables stripped, because nothing in lint, build or the unit tests may depend on a database.
The CI database is PostgreSQL 16 to match the production target recorded in ADR 0002 and docs/architecture/ARCHITECTURE.md, even though the development machine currently runs 18.6.

check-roadmap stays a content comparison between the pointer and its versioned file; comparing package.json and requiring a handoff entry is deliberately left to IP-059 so this version ships the cheapest check that closes the observed failure.

IP-050 and IP-051 are blocked, not merely unscheduled: both hang on which authority publishes the schedule this product follows, which docs/architecture/estimeter-operating-policy.md and IP-042 currently answer differently. Designing the document baseline against the wrong authority means migrating it once customer data sits in it.

items.title: Run the opt-in PostgreSQL suites in CI so the row lock, entitlement and trial-clock guarantees are machine-checked instead of hand-verified
Enable the pre-commit hook on every clone and run the quality gate on feature branches
Make check-roadmap refuse a pointer that has drifted from its versioned file
Extend check-roadmap further: compare package.json version with the roadmap pointer and require the handoff the roadmap claims to exist
Enforce capabilities.read on every ESTIMETR read path so the platform kill switch stops reads, not only writes
Order organization selection deterministically before a member can belong to more than one organization
Seed the Factor F table as a versioned dataset carrying its interest rate, source checksum and reviewer
Give price observations a unit, a material and labour split, and a condition, because the official labour schedule prices one item at several rates
Require a human verification step before any OCR-extracted price or factor can be used in a calculation
Validate the official source for ปร.4, ปร.5 and ปร.6 before claiming export compliance, starting by settling which authority publishes the schedule this product follows
Apply GitHub branch protection once the plan upgrade allows it
